en: The image is a black-and-white photograph showing eight men, most of whom are seated at a rustic wooden table outdoors, with one man standing behind them. The men appear to be engaged in shoemaking or cobbling, as there are numerous shoes, boots, tools, and tins on the table and shoes hanging on the wall behind them. The setting is a courtyard or workshop area with rough brick and stone walls, and a wooden door is open in the background. The men wear work clothes and aprons, and their expressions are serious.
